name: Commerce defaults
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Commerce defaults.
Choose whether successful additions open the cart drawer, and which purchase surfaces trigger it. Disabling the drawer retains the native cart journey.
Configure any free-shipping or reward milestones in Shopify before entering matching amounts here. Select an actual gift-wrap product if you offer it; the theme adds that product as a cart line.
Wishlist controls store saved products in the shopper’s current browser. Choose a page using the wishlist template before enabling its navigation link.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Enable quick add
settings.info: Default for shared product cards and search results. Explicit host quick-add settings take priority.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable quick add” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show SALE/NEW/low stock badges
settings.info: Default for shared product cards and search results. Explicit host badge settings take priority.
settings.how: Turn on “Show SALE/NEW/low stock badges” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show shipping threshold progress
settings.info: Display only; does not grant free shipping. Configure matching shipping rates in Shopify. Uses the current cart currency, without currency conversion.
settings.how: Set the actual cart amount for the corresponding shipping or promotional milestone. Configure the matching shipping rate or discount separately in Shopify; this display does not apply a benefit.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold amount
settings.info: Amount in the current cart currency. Zero or a negative amount hides progress. Confirm the threshold for every active market.
settings.how: Set the actual cart amount for the corresponding shipping or promotional milestone. Configure the matching shipping rate or discount separately in Shopify; this display does not apply a benefit.

settings.label: Enable AJAX cart drawer
settings.how: Turn on “Enable AJAX cart drawer” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Open cart drawer after add to cart
settings.how: Turn on “Open cart drawer after add to cart” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Enable header cart icon drawer trigger
settings.info: When disabled, the cart icon opens the cart page.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable header cart icon drawer trigger” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Use drawer for product forms
settings.info: Shared product-page and featured-product forms. Disabled forms keep native cart submission. Bundle sections retain their explicit add mode.
settings.how: Turn on “Use drawer for product forms” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Enable collection quick add drawer trigger
settings.info: Shared product-card and quick-view forms. Disabled forms keep native cart submission.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable collection quick add drawer trigger” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Enable cart add-on drawer refresh
settings.info: Enhances native add-on forms from the cart page. Does not create drawer add-on products.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable cart add-on drawer refresh” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Drawer width (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust drawer width (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Show continue shopping link
settings.how: Turn on “Show continue shopping link” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show shipping progress in drawer
settings.info: Requires shipping threshold progress above. Cart-page reward blocks remain section-owned.
settings.how: Turn on “Show shipping progress in drawer” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Drawer background
settings.how: Choose a color for drawer background. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Drawer panel background
settings.how: Choose a color for drawer panel background. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Drawer text color
settings.how: Choose a color for drawer text color. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Overlay opacity
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust overlay opacity. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Cart summary note
settings.info: Shown in the cart summary above the checkout button. Does not change Shopify checkout.
settings.how: Enter the cart summary note. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Show wishlist on product cards
settings.how: Turn on “Show wishlist on product cards” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Wishlist page
settings.how: Choose an existing Shopify page. Edit the page’s content separately in Online Store > Pages.

settings.label: Tier 1 amount
settings.info: Leave blank to disable. Configure the actual reward in Shopify discounts or shipping settings.
settings.how: Set the actual cart amount for the corresponding shipping or promotional milestone. Configure the matching shipping rate or discount separately in Shopify; this display does not apply a benefit.

settings.label: Tier 1 label
settings.how: Enter the tier 1 label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Tier 2 amount
settings.info: Leave blank to disable. Configure the actual reward in Shopify discounts or shipping settings.
settings.how: Set the actual cart amount for the corresponding shipping or promotional milestone. Configure the matching shipping rate or discount separately in Shopify; this display does not apply a benefit.

settings.label: Tier 2 label
settings.how: Enter the tier 2 label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Tier 3 amount
settings.info: Leave blank to disable. Configure the actual reward in Shopify discounts or shipping settings.
settings.how: Set the actual cart amount for the corresponding shipping or promotional milestone. Configure the matching shipping rate or discount separately in Shopify; this display does not apply a benefit.

settings.label: Tier 3 label
settings.how: Enter the tier 3 label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Drawer add-on product
settings.how: Choose an existing product from Products. Edit its price, inventory, variants, and media in the product record; this control chooses what the section displays.

settings.label: Offer gift wrap
settings.how: Turn on “Offer gift wrap” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Gift-wrap product
settings.info: Select a product with one variant, no subscription, and a minimum quantity of one.
settings.how: Choose an existing product from Products. Edit its price, inventory, variants, and media in the product record; this control chooses what the section displays.

settings.label: Wishlist link override
settings.info: Optional URL for a preview template or custom wishlist destination.
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.
